name: Suf
title: Ephraim's ancestor
summary: Suf (also known as Sutela/Sjutelah) was a descendant of Ephraim and an ancestor in the tribe of Ephraim. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles and is known as a forefather in the lineage that led to Joshua, son of Nun. His significance lies primarily in his place in Ephraim's family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's family tree
keyEvents.description: Suf is mentioned as a son of Ephraim in the genealogical register of the tribe of Ephraim, as part of the important tribal line.

keyEvents.title: The lineage from Ephraim
keyEvents.description: Suf is placed in the genealogical line from Ephraim, Joseph's son, who was one of the twelve patriarchs of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Joshua
keyEvents.description: Through Suf's lineage, several generations descend that eventually lead to Nun and his son Joshua, Israel's leader after Moses.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's grief over his sons
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, the story is told of Ephraim's sons and the tragedy that befell some of them when they were killed by men from Gath, linking Suf to this family history.

keyEvents.title: Recorded in the Numbers census
keyEvents.description: Suf's descendants, the Shuthelahites, were registered as a clan during the census on the plains of Moab in the Book of Numbers.
